Two coders independently annotated sufficient (for Inpatient) or complete (for Profee) evidence for the same three charts, and we measured the inter-coder agreement. Next, they reviewed each other's annotations where they disagreed to investigate the reasons for disagreement and determine if they could reach an agreement.
guideline: Reference the latest coding book to decide whether an ICD-10 code is supported by the documentation. If there is a definitive diagnosis, do not code symptom codes, otherwise symptom codes can be coded. Code external cause codes only with injury codes. Code as in real life, once a condition is confirmed and you feel comfortable with a code assignment, annotate the text spans with the code and move on to the next one.
